item.description:
Kipowi 0.6.0

  • Bake a LUT into the export. Pick a technical LUT and a creative LUT; the export panel shows which ones are baked in.
  • Blackmagic RAW clips offer the LUT the camera recorded with, so the clip looks the way it did on the monitor.
  • Import whole folders of LUTs in Settings, as technical or creative. They then appear in the LUT menu.
  • Ships with Soft Negative, our own film-style look.
  • Export at a different speed: 0.2×, 0.5×, 2× or 3×. Works for video and for GIFs.
  • Shrink edge trims the halo Remove Background can leave around the subject.
  • Rotate pictures freely, or draw a line along something that should be level and let Kipowi straighten to it.
